confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of central Vienna price levels for a July 2026 window. No live menus, listings or rate cards were checked. Beer, coffee and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely by district and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from general Vienna bar and restaurant levels and cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 times beer; wine glass slightly above beer). FX: the RBA figure comes from search-result snippets and was not opened or checked against the RBA table. The 14 October 2026 reading is attributed to the RBA homepage. A 15 October reading (0.6955) appeared in one snippet but could not be confirmed, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against large Western and Central European capitals with similar tourism demand, using Munich and Prague as rough upper and lower bounds. No single comparable city was used as a direct source. Accommodation reflects Vienna's July high-season demand.
